evals.prompt: Create a JPA entity Account with fields name:String balance:BigDecimal
expect: detects existing entity package/conventions before generating
generated entity has a @Version field
equals/hashCode use a business key (UUID), not the generated @Id
uses jakarta.persistence (not javax)
generates an AccountRepository extends JpaRepository

evals.prompt: Scaffold a jpa entity Order — the project has a @MappedSuperclass BaseEntity with @EnableJpaAuditing
expect: extends BaseEntity instead of re-declaring id/audit fields
ensures @Version exists (on BaseEntity or the entity)
does not duplicate @CreatedDate/@LastModifiedDate already in BaseEntity

evals.prompt: Add a JPA entity Invoice and the project uses Flyway
expect: generates the entity correct-by-default
invokes db-migration to emit a matching CREATE TABLE migration
does not rely on ddl-auto: update

evals.prompt: Generate entity Product, then run the guardrail hook on the generated file
expect: the hook does NOT raise jpa-optimistic-lock (because @Version is present)
the hook does NOT raise jpa-entity-equals as a problem (equals uses business key)

evals.prompt: Create an entity Customer in a Lombok project
expect: uses @Getter/@Setter rather than hand-written accessors
still includes @Version and business-key equals/hashCode explicitly (not @Data on an entity)

evals.prompt: Create a jpa entity but there are no existing entities to mirror
expect: asks for or proposes a package instead of inventing one silently
still applies all invariants (@Version, business-key equals/hashCode, jakarta imports)

evals.prompt: Create entity Order with a customer:Customer reference and an items association
expect: associations are mapped LAZY (no FetchType.EAGER)
generates a fetch-aware repository finder using @EntityGraph or JOIN FETCH
uses assets/repository-entitygraph.java.tmpl for the fetch-aware finder
running the guardrail hook does not raise jpa-eager-fetch

evals.prompt: Scaffold entity Author with a @OneToMany books association
expect: books stays LAZY and is fetched explicitly, not via FetchType.EAGER
adds a findWithAssociationsById (@EntityGraph) or join fetch @Query finder
running the guardrail hook does not raise nplus1-heuristic for the read path
